Container.Name: myTickrs
Container.Overview: myTickrs tracks your investment portfolio: lots, cost basis, profit and loss, and returns, with market data from built-in and plugin providers. Your data stays in a SQLite database in appdata, and can optionally sync with the myTickrs cloud.[br][br]Security: the self-hosted edition has no sign-in. Anyone who can reach the port can use the app, so do not expose it outside your network.[br][br]If you change the WebUI port, set PORT to the same number.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface. Keep it equal to PORT.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Must equal the WebUI port.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: SQLite database and the key that encrypts stored provider keys. Back up the whole folder; keep the key with the database.

Config.Name: Data-provider plugins
Config.Description: Optional. Folder for extra data-provider plugins. Leave empty to use the plugins built into the image; a folder here replaces them.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as and that owns App Data. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace or silent.

Config.Name: KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Base64 of 32 bytes that encrypts stored provider keys. If empty, one is generated and saved in App Data.
